crossRefs.note: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

parallels.note: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

translations.web: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: And whether it is a bed or furniture on which she was sitting, whoever touches it will be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
